recap.text: Rishi tables an action item for Juice Box to create a tenth team of NPCs with the same protections as other crawlers. He offers a compromise where unaffiliated NPCs receive invulnerability this season and a safe area. In return, Juice Box must stop her attacks or the Sultanate will respond harshly.

Sultan Rishi the Usurper explains that Vinata and her circle intended to steal a fleet and run in a direction none of the tunnel threads point. Rishi buried himself in dirt to avoid dying in a temple with his wife. He offers Crawler Carl citizenship in Naga lands for Earth natives if the Naga settle other planets. Crawler Carl tells him to drive the ships into a star and marks him with the Night Wyrm's Ring of Divine Suffering.

Crawler Carl opens a fan box and the inventory of the late Sultan Rishi the Usurper lands in the safe room. The items include makeup samples for a merchandise line Princess Donut did not approve. The cleaner bot has not recovered.

beats.headline: A compromise, with a warning attached
beats.text: The crawler tables an action item on Juice Box's behalf: a tenth team drawn from the NPCs, holding the same protections the rest of us hold. My position is a compromise. A team of her own and she will surely dominate the game. So: the unaffiliated NPCs are given invulnerability this season and a safe area the rest of us may not enter, and in return her attacks stop. Should they not, the Sultanate is quite versed in dealing with terrorism and will respond harshly, and I would like the minutes to show that I said so here, first, and calmly.
beats.gist: Rishi offers a compromise to stop Juice Box's attacks.

beats.headline: The Great Consensus, and a fleet
beats.text: They have me, so they may have the rest of it. The philosophy is called the Great Consensus, and Vinata was an adherent of it, and what her circle intended was to steal the entire fleet and run with it, for a generation, in a direction none of the tunnel threads point. I did not walk into that temple beside my wife. I knew what was waiting inside it, and I knew that going in with her made me as dead as she is. So I stayed outside, and buried myself in the dirt, and here I am, with something to trade.
beats.gist: Sultan Rishi the Usurper is a character.

beats.headline: The offer, and the ring
beats.text: For the record: the prisoner offered Crawler Carl a signed instrument granting every native of Earth citizenship in Naga lands, in exchange for the Naga settling the other planets of Earth's system. A real document, and worth something. Crawler Carl told him to take the ships and drive them into the nearest star, and marked him with the Night Wyrm's Ring of Divine Suffering. Then he told the Naga audience they were about to watch another of their so-called leaders killed, and that Sultan Rishi the Usurper, First of his Name, was the opening act.
beats.gist: Carl marks Sultan Rishi the Usurper with the Night Wyrm's Ring of Divine Suffering.

beats.headline: His belongings arrive in the safe room
beats.text: Housekeeping. Crawler Carl opened a fan box and the entire contents of the late Sultan's inventory landed in the middle of the safe room. Among it: makeup samples for a merchandise line built around Princess Donut, which Princess Donut had not approved, and about which she has a very great deal to say. The cleaner bot has not recovered.
beats.gist: Carl opens a fan box and the late Sultan Rishi's inventory lands in the safe room.
